title: The Trade-off between Performance, Efficiency, and Fairness in Adapter Modules for Text Classification
findings: On the HateXplain dataset, adapter modules consistently decreased fairness for the religion category, particularly for RoBERTa_large with LoRA and Adapters (4.9% and 3.6% decrease in Equalized Odds, respectively). On the Jigsaw dataset, the effects were more mixed. The overall finding is that when a base model already exhibits high bias, the impact of adapter modules becomes more variable and unpredictable, posing a risk of amplifying existing biases.
